ABOUT MUNDO DE PALABRA

An online school for Spanish learners.

For kids and adults learning to speak Spanish for daily life, work, or a move to Spain.

MEET THE OWNER

Dave Lapana

Dave owns Mundo De Palabras, an online Spanish school offering live group and one-on-one classes. Students can start with everyday phrases and work toward conversations for bilingual customer service or life in Spain.
